description: A token made elsewhere, as the chain has it: given its mint’s address, returns its ready `tokens` entry (`source: "existing"`) with its name, ticker, decimals and token program, and `powers`: what the mint’s own keys can do (mint more, freeze, a transfer fee, a transfer hook, a permanent delegate, a pause…), in words too. Reads devnet: the mint and its name record only, not the link the record names.

key.description: What the spec will call it (default: its ticker, in the letters a key takes).

project.description: The loot project’s address, when the token is one the project is to mint on a mint of its own: its mint authority then reads as the project’s, or as not handed over yet.

name: xsolana_token
title: Read a token made elsewhere
